name: openbb_index_available
description:
Market indices a provider covers (symbol, name and code) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.index.available).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 500; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, yfinance; default yfinance).
Index history: openbb_index_price_historical, yf_index_history. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"limit": 50}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
